Let <MATH_0001> be a morphism of locally ringed spaces.
Let <MATH_0002> be a sheaf of
ideals which is locally generated by sections.
Let <MATH_0003> be the closed subspace associated to the
sheaf of ideals <MATH_0004>.
Let <MATH_0005> be the image of the map
<MATH_0006>.
Then this ideal is locally generated by sections.
Moreover, let <MATH_0007> be the associated closed
subspace of <MATH_0008>. There exists a unique
morphism of locally ringed spaces <MATH_0009> such
that the following diagram is a commutative square of
locally ringed spaces
<MATH_0010>
Moreover, this diagram is a fibre square in the category of
locally ringed spaces.

The ideal <MATH_0001> is locally generated by sections
by Modules, Lemma <REF_0001>.
The rest of the lemma follows from the characterization,
in Lemma <REF_0002> above,
of what it means for a morphism to factor through a closed
subspace.
